mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( user_id, type, title, content, is_read, reference_id, reference_type, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, COALESCE(#{isRead}, 'N'), #{referenceId}, #{referenceType}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, type, title, content, is_read AS isRead, reference_id AS referenceId, reference_type AS referenceType, created_at AS createdAt FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 'N' ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, type, title, content, is_read AS isRead, reference_id AS referenceId, reference_type AS referenceType, created_at AS createdAt FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 'Y' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 'N'
